# Data dan Eksplorasi Awal
```{r}
data<-read.csv("D:/Kuliah/Semester 5/Metode Peramalan Deret Waktu/SN_d_tot_V2.0.csv", sep=";")
colnames(data)<-c("Tahun", "Bulan", "Hari", "Desimal", "Sunspot", "SD", "Obs", "Def")
data <- subset(data, (Tahun > 1926 | (Tahun == 1926 & Bulan >= 1)) & (Tahun < 2025 | (Tahun == 2025 & Bulan <= 12)))
data
```
```{r}
summary(data$Sunspot)
```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```
```{r}
plot(data$Desimal, data$Sunspot, 
     type = "l", col = "gray50", 
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Sunspot", 
     main = "Plot Data Mentah Sunspot (1926 - 2025)")
```
```{r}
data_bulanan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun + Bulan, data = data, FUN = mean)
data_bulanan <- data_bulanan[order(data_bulanan$Tahun, data_bulanan$Bulan), ]
ts_bulanan <- ts(data_bulanan$Sunspot, start = c(1926, 1), frequency = 12)
```

```{r}
plot(ts_bulanan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Bulanan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - Desember 2025)")
```
```{r}
data_tahunan <- aggregate(Sunspot ~ Tahun, data = data, FUN = mean)
ts_tahunan <- ts(data_tahunan$Sunspot, start = 1926, frequency = 1)
plot(ts_tahunan, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Tahunan Sunspot (Januari 1926 - Desember 2025)")
```
```{r}
dec_sunspot <- decompose(ts_bulanan, type = "additive")
plot(dec_sunspot)
```
```{r}
seasonplot(ts_tahunan, 
           s = 11, 
           main = "Seasonal Plot of Sunspot (11-Year Cycle)", 
           ylab = "Jumlah Sunspot",
           xlab = "Tahun ke- dalam Siklus",
           year.labels = TRUE, 
           col = rainbow(10), 
           pch = 19)
```

```{r}
monthplot(ts_bulanan, ylab = "Sunspot (ppm)", col = "darkblue", 
          main = "Monthplot Data Sunspot")
```
```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = as.factor(Tahun), y = Sunspot)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", color = "black", outlier.size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 8)) +

       y = "Jumlah Sunspot")
```

# Pembagian Training dan Testing Data
```{r}
ts_sunspot<-ts_tahunan
n_total <- length(ts_sunspot)
n_test <- 20
n_train <- n_total - n_test

train_data <- window(ts_sunspot, end = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train])
test_data <- window(ts_sunspot, start = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train + 1])
```
```{r}
plot(train_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Training")
```
```{r}
plot(test_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Testing")
```

```{r}
min(train_data)
```


# Uji Stasioneritas
## Uji Fligner-Killeen
```{r}
data$Periode <- cut(data$Tahun, 
                         breaks = c(1925, 1950, 1975, 2000, 2025), 
                         labels = c("1926-1950", "1951-1975", "1976-2000", "2001-2025"))

fligner.test(Sunspot ~ Periode, data = data)
```
## Uji ADF
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(train_data)
```
# Penanganan Ragam Tidak Stasioner
```{r}
train_log <- log(train_data)
test_log <- log(test_data)

plot.ts(train_log, type="l", col="black", main="Plot Data Log(Sunspot)")
```
```{r}
tseries::adf.test(train_log)
```
```{r}
df_log <- data.frame(
  Tahun = as.numeric(time(train_log)),
  Sunspot_Log = as.numeric(train_log)
)

df_log$Periode <- cut(df_log$Tahun, 
                      breaks = 4, 
                      labels = c("Periode 1", "Periode 2", "Periode 3", "Periode 4"))

fligner.test(Sunspot_Log ~ Periode, data = df_log)
```

# Non-Seasonal
## ACF
```{r}
acf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```

## PACF
```{r}
pacf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```
Tanpa differencing karena stasioner dalam rataan (d=0). PACF cut off, indikasi AR(2) (p=2). ACF tails off, indikasi MA(0) (q=0). 
# Seasonal 
## Lag 11
### Differencing
```{r}
D1 <- diff(train_log, lag = 11) 
plot.ts(D1, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
Indikasi D=1, s=11.
### ACF setelah differencing musiman
```{r}
acf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
ACF cut off setelah lag musiman, indikasi Seasonal MA (Q=1 atau Q=0). Indikasi q=1.
### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
PACF tails off di lag musiman dan kelipatannya, indikasi Seasonal AR (P=1). Indikasi p=1 atau p=2.

## Lag 5
### Differencing
```{r}
D2 <- diff(train_log, lag = 5) 
plot.ts(D2, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
### ACF setelah differencing
```{r}
acf(D2, lag.max = 55, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 5")
```
Hasil differencing berkali2 tetap membuat ACF di lag 5 dan kelipatannya melewati garis putus.

### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D2, lag.max = 55, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 5")
```
Indikasi P=1.

## Uji Formal
### Sisaan menyebar normal

```{r}

```

```{r}

fitted_asli <- exp(fitted_log)
aktual_asli <- as.numeric(train_data) 
sisaan_asli <- aktual_asli - fitted_asli
shapiro.test(sisaan_asli)
```
```{r}
kurtosis(sisaan)
skewness(sisaan)
```
```{r}
tahun_train <- as.numeric(time(train_data))
out_idx <- which(abs(scale(sisaan)) > 2.5)

data.frame(
  Tahun     = tahun_train[out_idx],
  Residual  = round(sisaan[out_idx], 3),
  Z_score   = round(scale(sisaan)[out_idx], 2)
)
```

```{r}
tahun_train <- as.numeric(time(train_data))
out_idx <- which(abs(scale(sisaan)) > 2.5)   

sisaan_tanpa <- sisaan[-out_idx]
```

#### Dummy
```{r}
tahun_train <- as.numeric(time(train_data))

dummy_1955 <- as.numeric(tahun_train == 1955)

model6_dummy <- Arima(train_log,
                      order = c(2,0,1),
                      seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,1), period = 11),
                      xreg = dummy_1955)

summary(model6_dummy)
lmtest::coeftest(model6_dummy)   
dummy_1955
```
```{r}
sisaan_red <- residuals(model6_dummy)
shapiro.test(sisaan_red)
kurtosis(sisaan_red); skewness(sisaan_red)
Box.test(sisaan_red, type = "Ljung", lag = 22)
Box.test((sisaan_red)^2, type = "Ljung", lag = 22)
t.test(sisaan_red, mu = 0)
```

# Model SARIMA-GARCH
## GARCH
```{r}
spec <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model     = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,1)),
  mean.model         = list(armaOrder = c(0,0), include.mean = FALSE),  
  distribution.model = "std"
)

fit_garch <- ugarchfit(spec, data = as.numeric(residuals(model6_dummy)),
                       solver = "hybrid")
fit_garch

res_std <- residuals(fit_garch, standardize = TRUE)
Box.test((as.numeric(res_std))^2, type = "Ljung", lag = 22) 
shapiro.test(as.numeric(res_std))

garch_fc <- ugarchforecast(fit_garch, n.ahead = length(test_data))
sigma_fc <- as.numeric(sigma(garch_fc))

mean_fc <- as.numeric(prediksi_asli)
ci_lower <- mean_fc - 1.96 * sigma_fc
ci_upper <- mean_fc + 1.96 * sigma_fc
```
## ARCH
```{r}
spec_arch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model     = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,0)),  # ARCH(1)
  mean.model         = list(armaOrder = c(0,0), include.mean = FALSE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)
fit_arch <- ugarchfit(spec_arch, data = as.numeric(residuals(model6_dummy)),
                      solver = "hybrid")
fit_arch
```
```{r}
c(GARCH11 = infocriteria(fit_garch)[1],
  ARCH1  = infocriteria(fit_arch)[1])
```

```{r}
res_std_arch <- residuals(fit_arch, standardize = TRUE)

Box.test(as.numeric(res_std_arch)^2, type = "Ljung", lag = 22)   
Box.test(as.numeric(res_std_arch),    type = "Ljung", lag = 22)   
shapiro.test(as.numeric(res_std_arch))                           
t.test(as.numeric(res_std_arch), mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95) 
kurtosis(as.numeric(res_std_arch)); skewness(as.numeric(res_std_arch))
```
## IGARCH
```{r}
spec_igarch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model     = list(model = "iGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,1)),
  mean.model         = list(armaOrder = c(0,0), include.mean = FALSE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)
fit_igarch <- ugarchfit(spec_igarch, data = as.numeric(residuals(model6_dummy)),
                        solver = "hybrid")
fit_igarch
```

## Model kedua
```{r}
model_tbats_coba <- tbats(train_data, seasonal.periods = c(11, 5.5))
model_tbats_coba
```

```{r}
checkresiduals(model_tbats_coba)
sisaan_coba<-residuals(model_tbats_coba)
shapiro.test(sisaan_coba)
t.test(sisaan_coba, mu=0)
Box.test(sisaan_coba, lag=22, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(sisaan_coba, lag=11, type="Ljung-Box")
Box.test((sisaan_coba)^2, lag=22, type="Ljung")
Box.test((sisaan_coba)^2, lag=11, type="Ljung")
```
```{r}
sisaan_tbats_B <- residuals(model_tbats_coba)
acf(sisaan_tbats_B, lag.max = 30)

for (lag_test in c(10, 15, 22, 30)) {
  cat("Lag", lag_test, ": p =", 
      Box.test(sisaan_tbats_B, type = "Ljung", lag = lag_test)$p.value, "\n")
}
```
```{r}
sisaan_tbats_B <- residuals(model_tbats_coba)
acf_obj <- acf(sisaan_tbats_B, lag.max = 30, plot = FALSE)

acf_obj$acf[6]   
acf_obj$acf[11]  
```
```{r}
res_tbats <- residuals(model_tbats_coba)
res_ts <- ts(as.numeric(res_tbats), frequency = 5)

model_res_auto <- auto.arima(res_ts, 
                              seasonal = TRUE,
                              stepwise = FALSE, 
                              approximation = FALSE)
summary(model_res_auto)
lmtest::coeftest(model_res_auto)
```
```{r}
res_hybrid <- residuals(model_res_auto)

Box.test(res_hybrid, type = "Ljung", lag = 10)   
Box.test(res_hybrid, type = "Ljung", lag = 22)   
Box.test(res_hybrid^2, type = "Ljung", lag = 10)   
Box.test(res_hybrid^2, type = "Ljung", lag = 22) 
shapiro.test(res_hybrid)                          
t.test(res_hybrid, mu = 0)                        

acf(res_hybrid, lag.max = 30)
```
```{r}
spec_igarch_tbats <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model     = list(model = "iGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,1)),
  mean.model         = list(armaOrder = c(0,0), include.mean = FALSE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)
fit_igarch_tbats <- ugarchfit(spec_igarch_tbats, 
                                data = as.numeric(res_hybrid),
                                solver = "hybrid")
fit_igarch_tbats

res_std_tbats <- as.numeric(residuals(fit_igarch_tbats, standardize = TRUE))
Box.test(res_std_tbats^2, type = "Ljung", lag = 22)   # harus lolos
shapiro.test(res_std_tbats)
```
```{r}
train_log     <- log(as.numeric(train_data))
train_log_ts  <- ts(train_log, start = start(train_data), frequency = 1)

model_tbats_log <- tbats(train_log_ts, seasonal.periods = c(11, 5.5))
summary(model_tbats_log)

res_log <- residuals(model_tbats_log)
Box.test(res_log,   type = "Ljung", lag = 10)   
Box.test(res_log,   type = "Ljung", lag = 22)
shapiro.test(res_log)                           
Box.test(res_log^2, type = "Ljung", lag = 22)   
t.test(res_log, mu = 0)

res_log_ts <- ts(as.numeric(res_log), frequency = 5)
model_res_log <- auto.arima(res_log_ts, seasonal = TRUE,
                              stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
```

# Model Fourier
```{r}
buat_fourier <- function(waktu, periode = 11, K = 2) {
  hasil <- matrix(nrow = length(waktu), ncol = 2 * K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    hasil[, 2*k-1] <- sin(2 * pi * k * waktu / periode)
    hasil[, 2*k]   <- cos(2 * pi * k * waktu / periode)
  }
  colnames(hasil) <- paste0(rep(c("sin", "cos"), K), rep(1:K, each = 2))
  return(hasil)
}

waktu_train <- seq_along(train_data)
waktu_test  <- length(train_data) + seq_along(test_data)

fourier_train_k1 <- buat_fourier(waktu_train, periode = 11, K = 1)
fourier_test_k1  <- buat_fourier(waktu_test,  periode = 11, K = 1)

fourier_train_k2 <- buat_fourier(waktu_train, periode = 11, K = 2)
fourier_test_k2  <- buat_fourier(waktu_test,  periode = 11, K = 2)
```

```{r}
konst_jacob <- 2 * sum(log(as.numeric(train_data)))

get_ic <- function(model, name, is_log = FALSE, komponen = "Mean") {
  if (inherits(model, "tbats")) {
    n <- length(model$y); k <- length(coef(model))
    AIC_val  <- model$AIC
    AICc_val <- AIC_val + (2*k*(k+1))/(n-k-1)
    logLik_v <- (2*k - AIC_val)/2
    BIC_val  <- -2*logLik_v + k*log(n)
  } else if (inherits(model, "HoltWinters")) {
    n <- length(residuals(model)); k <- 3
    sse <- sum(residuals(model)^2)
    AIC_val  <- n*log(sse/n) + 2*k
    AICc_val <- AIC_val + (2*k*(k+1))/(n-k-1)
    BIC_val  <- n*log(sse/n) + k*log(n)
  } else {
    AIC_val  <- model$aic; AICc_val <- model$aicc; BIC_val <- model$bic
  }
  if (is_log) {
    AIC_val  <- AIC_val  + konst_jacob
    AICc_val <- AICc_val + konst_jacob
    BIC_val  <- BIC_val  + konst_jacob
  }
  data.frame(Model = name, Komponen = komponen,
             AIC = AIC_val, AICc = AICc_val, BIC = BIC_val)
}

get_ic_garch <- function(fit, name) {
  n  <- length(residuals(fit))
  ic <- infocriteria(fit)
  data.frame(Model = name, Komponen = "Variance",
             AIC = ic[1]*n, AICc = NA, BIC = ic[2]*n)
}

tabel_train <- rbind(
  get_ic(model6_dummy,     "SARIMA + dummy 1955 (Jacobian-adj)", is_log = TRUE),
  get_ic(model_ets,        "ETS (Auto)"),
  get_ic(hw,               "Holt-Winters"),
  get_ic(model_tbats,      "TBATS (s=11)"),
  get_ic(model_tbats_coba, "TBATS (s=11 & 5.5)"),
  get_ic(model_fourier_k1, "Fourier K=1"),
  get_ic(model_fourier_k2, "Fourier K=2"),
  get_ic_garch(fit_arch,   "ARCH(1)-t"),
  get_ic_garch(fit_garch,  "GARCH(1,1)-t"),
  get_ic_garch(fit_igarch, "iGARCH(1,1)-t")
)

tabel_train$Komponen <- factor(tabel_train$Komponen,
                                levels = c("Mean", "Variance"))
tabel_train <- tabel_train[order(tabel_train$Komponen, tabel_train$AICc, na.last = TRUE), ]
tabel_train[, 3:5] <- round(tabel_train[, 3:5], 2)
rownames(tabel_train) <- NULL

kable(tabel_train, 
      caption = "Information Criteria Model Conditional Mean dan Conditional Variance")
```

# Cross-Validation
```{r}
y        <- as.numeric(train_data)
t_y      <- as.numeric(time(train_data))
n        <- length(y)
h        <- 20                
min_orig <- 40               

origins  <- min_orig:(n - h)
n_folds  <- length(origins)

model_names <- c("SARIMA", "Fourier_K1", "Fourier_K2", "ETS", 
                 "HoltWinters", "TBATS_11", "TBATS_11_5.5", "SeasonalNaive",
                 "SARIMA_Dummy", "TBATS_Hybrid", "ETS_Hybrid")
errors_cv <- matrix(NA, n_folds, length(model_names))
colnames(errors_cv) <- model_names


for (k in seq_along(origins)) {
  origin    <- origins[k]
  tr        <- ts(y[1:origin], start = t_y[1], frequency = 1)
  actual_h1 <- y[origin + 1]
  t_idx     <- 1:origin
  
  fit_s <- tryCatch(forecast::Arima(log(tr), order = c(2,0,1),
                          seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,1), period = 11)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_s)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_s, h = h) 
    errors_cv[k, 1] <- actual_h1 - exp(fc$mean[1])
  }
  
  fr_tr_k1 <- cbind(sin(2*pi*t_idx/11), cos(2*pi*t_idx/11))
  fr_fu_k1 <- cbind(sin(2*pi*(origin+1)/11), cos(2*pi*(origin+1)/11))
  fit_f1 <- tryCatch(forecast::auto.arima(tr, xreg = fr_tr_k1, seasonal = FALSE),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_f1)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_f1, h = h, xreg = fr_fu_k1)
    errors_cv[k, 2] <- actual_h1 - fc$mean[1]
  }
  
  fr_tr_k2 <- cbind(sin(2*pi*t_idx/11), cos(2*pi*t_idx/11),
                    sin(4*pi*t_idx/11), cos(4*pi*t_idx/11))
  fr_fu_k2 <- cbind(sin(2*pi*(origin+1)/11), cos(2*pi*(origin+1)/11),
                    sin(4*pi*(origin+1)/11), cos(4*pi*(origin+1)/11))
  fit_f2 <- tryCatch(forecast::auto.arima(tr, xreg = fr_tr_k2, seasonal = FALSE),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_f2)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_f2, h = h, xreg = fr_fu_k2) 
    errors_cv[k, 3] <- actual_h1 - fc$mean[1]
  }
  
  tr_ts11 <- ts(tr, frequency = 11)
  fit_e <- tryCatch(forecast::ets(tr_ts11, model = "ZZZ"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_e)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_e, h = h) 
    errors_cv[k, 4] <- actual_h1 - fc$mean[1]
  }
  
  fit_h <- tryCatch(stats::HoltWinters(tr_ts11, seasonal = "additive"),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_h)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_h, h = h) 
    errors_cv[k, 5] <- actual_h1 - fc$mean[1]
  }
  
  fit_t1 <- tryCatch(forecast::tbats(tr, seasonal.periods = 11), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_t1)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_t1, h = h) 
    errors_cv[k, 6] <- actual_h1 - fc$mean[1]
  }
  
  fit_t2 <- tryCatch(forecast::tbats(tr, seasonal.periods = c(11, 5.5)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_t2)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_t2, h = h) 
    errors_cv[k, 7] <- actual_h1 - fc$mean[1]
  }
  
  fit_sn <- forecast::snaive(tr_ts11, h = h)
  errors_cv[k, 8] <- actual_h1 - fit_sn$mean[1]
  
  fit_sd <- tryCatch(forecast::Arima(log(tr), order = c(2,0,1),
                        seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,1), period = 11),
                        xreg = as.numeric(t_y[1:origin] == 1955)),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_sd)) {
    fc <- forecast::forecast(fit_sd, h = h, xreg = rep(0, h))
    errors_cv[k, 9] <- actual_h1 - exp(fc$mean[1])
  }
  
  if (!is.null(fit_t2)) {
    fit_th <- tryCatch({
      res_tb <- residuals(fit_t2)
      res_tb_ts <- ts(as.numeric(res_tb), frequency = 5)
      ar <- forecast::auto.arima(res_tb_ts, seasonal = TRUE,
                                   stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
      fc_tb <- forecast::forecast(fit_t2, h = h)
      fc_ar <- forecast::forecast(ar, h = h)
      as.numeric(fc_tb$mean[1]) + as.numeric(fc_ar$mean[1])
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit_th)) {
      errors_cv[k, 10] <- actual_h1 - fit_th
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(fit_e)) {
    fit_eh <- tryCatch({
      res_e <- residuals(fit_e)
      res_e_ts <- ts(as.numeric(res_e), frequency = 5)
      ar <- forecast::Arima(res_e_ts, order = c(0,0,4),
                             seasonal = list(order = c(0,0,2), period = 5),
                             fixed = c(0, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA),
                             include.mean = FALSE)
      fc_ets <- forecast::forecast(fit_e, h = h)
      fc_ar  <- forecast::forecast(ar, h = h)
      as.numeric(fc_ets$mean[1]) + as.numeric(fc_ar$mean[1])
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit_eh)) {
      errors_cv[k, 11] <- actual_h1 - fit_eh
    }
  }
  
  if (k %% 5 == 0) cat("Fold", k, "/", n_folds, "selesai...\n")
}

naive_mae_train <- mean(abs(diff(y, lag = 11)))

cv_summary <- data.frame(
  Model    = model_names,
  MAE_CV   = apply(errors_cv, 2, function(x) mean(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE)),
  RMSE_CV  = apply(errors_cv, 2, function(x) sqrt(mean(x^2, na.rm = TRUE)))
)
cv_summary$MASE_CV <- round(cv_summary$MAE_CV / naive_mae_train, 3)
cv_summary$RMSE_CV <- round(cv_summary$RMSE_CV, 3)
cv_summary$MAE_CV  <- round(cv_summary$MAE_CV, 3)
cv_summary <- cv_summary[order(cv_summary$MASE_CV), ]
rownames(cv_summary) <- NULL

kable(cv_summary, caption = "Perbandingan Kinerja Model Berdasarkan Cross-Validation")
```

# Plot
```{r}
annual <- data.frame(
  Year    = c(as.numeric(time(train_data)), as.numeric(time(test_data))),
  Sunspot = c(as.numeric(train_data), as.numeric(test_data))
)

yrs_test <- as.numeric(time(test_data))

preds <- list(
  "SARIMA (Model 6)"              = as.numeric(prediksi_asli),        
  "SARIMA + dummy + iGARCH"       = as.numeric(pred_sarima_dummy),    
  "ETS murni"                     = as.numeric(ramalan_ets$mean),
  "ETS-ARIMA hybrid"              = as.numeric(pred_ets_hybrid),      
  "TBATS (11 & 5.5) murni"        = as.numeric(ramalan_B$mean),
  "TBATS-ARIMA hybrid"            = as.numeric(pred_tbats_hybrid),    
  "Holt-Winters"                  = as.numeric(fc_hw$mean),
  "Fourier K=2"                   = as.numeric(ramalan_fourier_k2$mean),
  "Seasonal Naive"                = snaive_pred
)

long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(preds), function(nm)
  data.frame(Year = yrs_test, Model = nm, Nilai = preds[[nm]])))

dh <- subset(data.frame(Year = annual$Year, Nilai = annual$Sunspot), Year >= 1990)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = dh,   aes(Year, Nilai), linewidth = 1.1, color = "black") +
  geom_line(data = long, aes(Year, Nilai, color = Model), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = max(as.numeric(time(train_data))),
             linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Prediksi semua model vs aktual",
       x = "Tahun", y = "Sunspot") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
annual <- data.frame(
  Year    = c(as.numeric(time(train_data)), as.numeric(time(test_data))),
  Sunspot = c(as.numeric(train_data), as.numeric(test_data))
)

years_train <- as.numeric(time(train_data))
years_test  <- as.numeric(time(test_data))

fitted_sarima    <- exp(as.numeric(fitted(model6)))           
fitted_ets_arima <- as.numeric(fitted(model_ets)) + 
                    as.numeric(fitted(model_res_ets_v5))     

fc_sarima   <- as.numeric(prediksi_asli)      
fc_ets_arm  <- as.numeric(pred_ets_hybrid)   

long_fit <- rbind(
  data.frame(Year = years_train, Model = "SARIMA(2,0,1)(0,1,1)[11]",
             Nilai = fitted_sarima,    Type = "Fitted"),
  data.frame(Year = years_train, Model = "ETS-ARIMA hybrid",
             Nilai = fitted_ets_arima, Type = "Fitted")
)

long_fc <- rbind(
  data.frame(Year = years_test, Model = "SARIMA(2,0,1)(0,1,1)[11]",
             Nilai = fc_sarima,  Type = "Forecast"),
  data.frame(Year = years_test, Model = "ETS-ARIMA hybrid",
             Nilai = fc_ets_arm, Type = "Forecast")
)

long_all <- rbind(long_fit, long_fc)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = annual, aes(Year, Sunspot),
            linewidth = 1.1, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = long_all,
            aes(Year, Nilai, color = Model, linetype = Type),
            linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = max(years_train),
             linetype = "dotted", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Fitted" = "solid", "Forecast" = "dashed"),
    labels = c("Fitted (in-sample 1926–2005)",
               "Forecast (out-of-sample 2006–2025)")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "SARIMA(2,0,1)(0,1,1)[11] vs ETS-ARIMA hybrid (1926–2025)",
    subtitle = "Hitam = aktual; solid = fitted; dashed = forecast; merah = batas training/testing",
    x = "Tahun", y = "Sunspot",
    color = NULL, linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
